categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in four segments: (1) Film technology and investment, production, promotion and distribution platform, including film ticketing and technology services; (2) Damai ticketing and live entertainment platform, focusing on live event ticketing and content production; (3) IP merchandising, involving IP licensing, merchandise sales, and pop toy integration; and (4) Drama series production, producing and distributing television drama content.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies such as AI algorithms, big data, virtual filming, digital humans, and intelligent promotion and distribution systems to enhance content creation, production efficiency, and user experience. It operates virtual filming studios and develops digital human endorsements, integrating technology deeply into film, live entertainment, and IP merchandising.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include cinema-goers, live entertainment audiences, IP brand partners, merchants, and consumers in the cultural and entertainment sectors. The company serves the film, television, live performance, and merchandise markets, targeting Generation Z, family user groups, and broader entertainment consumers.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s operations are primarily based in Mainland China, with significant activities in Hong Kong and expanding presence in the Greater Bay Area and Southeast Asia. It is actively pursuing globalization strategies to connect domestic and international markets, including ticketing services for overseas performances and international IP introduction.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates across multiple points in the entertainment supply chain, including upstream content production (film and drama series), midstream technology platforms (ticketing and digital services), and downstream commercialization (IP merchandising and live event operations), effectively integrating upstream and downstream activities.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding content production capabilities, integrating AI and virtual production technologies, enhancing user engagement through ticketing platform integration, scaling IP merchandising with cross-sector operations, and accelerating overseas expansion. R&D focuses on AI-driven innovation in content creation, digital humans, virtual filming, and intelligent ticketing systems.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through multiple streams: service fees from film and live event ticketing platforms, licensing fees and sales from IP merchandising, investment income from film and drama production, and direct sales of merchandise and pop toys. The company also earns from live entertainment content production and distribution.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading player in China’s entertainment ecosystem, particularly dominant in live event ticketing through Damai and IP licensing via AliFish. It competes with other film production and distribution companies, live entertainment platforms, and IP merchandising firms, positioning itself as a diversified entertainment ecosystem operator and technology innovator.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the year ended March 31, 2025, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB6.7 billion, a 33% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to owners of RMB364 million, up 28%. Adjusted EBITA grew 61% to RMB809 million. The company has shown resilient growth despite industry challenges, with expanding segments like Damai and IP merchandising driving revenue increases.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself by integrating content and technology to create a diversified entertainment ecosystem platform. It offers a comprehensive ticketing service covering film and live events, leverages AI and virtual production to enhance content quality and efficiency, and operates a leading IP licensing commercialization platform with a full-chain service model. Its focus on experiential consumption and user loyalty through membership programs further strengthens its competitive edge.
